note: Small private campground off IL-130 north of Olney: about ten back-in gravel sites along the south shore of a small wooded pond, with a walking trail around it. No website. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $35 a night in April and November 2026 (RV Life reviews). --Claude
summary: No operator web page exists (Google listing 4.8/36 + RV Life only). Priced from two dated 2026 RV Life camper reports at $35 (passes the $50 gate; no gateway; not Good Sam). Booking by phone. WATERFRONT: the 'lake' is ~1 ha (~2.5 acres), a pond under the 5-acre rule, so stored 'lakefront' is the wrong value; the south-shore pads sit ~10-25 m from the water through scattered trees (RV Life photo shows water just behind a pad) -> proposes 'pond'. Pin ~140 m from the RV pads, kept. Long-stay share not measurable.
flags: WATERFRONT CHANGE PROPOSED: lakefront -> pond. Measured on Esri imagery: the water is about 150 x 65 m (~1 ha, ~2.5 acres), under the ~5-acre pond line (docs/campground-curation.md 'Lake or pond'), so 'lakefront' cannot stand whatever the setback. The RV pads are on the south shore around 38.7950,-88.0924, 10-25 m from the water through scattered trees (not a continuous screen in the photo); the RV Life photo (Class C on a back-in gravel pad with a pedestal) shows the water a few metres behind the pad. No site numbers are published anywhere, so the waterfront sites cannot be named; the pads are sold by the night (two 2026 nightly reviews). If the reviewer requires named sites, the fallback is 'not waterfront' (there is no pond-view value).
PRICE/PRESENCE: no operator website; rate is camper-reported $35 (RV Life, stays 4/2026 and 11/2026). Gate passes at $35; gateways.py none within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park.

WEBSITE: stored https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/regions/illinois/olney/taylor-lake-campground-254358 is an aggregator, not the operator's page; no operator page exists. Suggest clearing it (website -> none) or leaving it as the only listing; reviewer's call.
GOOGLE: 4.8 stars / 36 reviews (Google Maps, 2026-11-12). Phone 618-392-2800 unchanged (Google and RV Life agree).

LONG-STAY: nightly share not measurable (no site map or rules). Signals for nightly use: the April 2026 overnight motorhome stay and the November 2026 fifth-wheel stay, both $35/night. No operator wording discouraging nightly guests (there is no operator text at all). Imagery shows 3-4 rigs on ~10 pads.
PIN: stored 38.795,-88.094 sits on the access lane by the IL-130 farmstead; the RV pads are around 38.7950,-88.0924 (~140 m east). Under 250 m, kept.
FIT: a 2020 reviewer fit a 44-ft toy hauler on one lot but says 'larger campers will be a squeeze'; a 2026 reviewer overnighted a motorhome. A 23-ft rig fits.
Hookups (30/water/sewer) and sites.count 10 left as derived: the 4/2026 review confirms power/water/sewer at the site, nothing gives the amperage or the count.
